provenance.label: numerical solution of the stated model; not experimental validation
provenance.solver: STRATO BTCS five-layer spherical finite difference

markers: every release record is a set of discrete markers: bound markers (black downward triangles) at the bound value with no deviation and no status word; point markers only where a point comparison exists; no experimental line is drawn

observations.particle_applicability: compact with intact particles only; includes in-pile inventory already in the matrix (Morris et al. (2016) highlights: Ag, Eu and Sr release dominated by release during irradiation); not attributable to diffusion through a single intact particle during the test
observations.systematic_uncertainty: 5 % gamma counting (Stempien 2023 p. 10), kept separate and not combined into any number on a graph
premises: The reported total contains all material released by the compact during the test (no loss to uncounted surfaces; open point O13).

The kernel-only start (decision 20) differs from the real initial state in two ways with opposite effects: it ignores the inventory already outside the SiC (raises F_p) and the inventory already in the coatings (lowers F_p). The size of the difference is not stated here: the results pipeline computes it for Sr-90 and Cs-137 from the Scenario 5 heating runs against the kernel-only runs of the same histories and writes it into the files curves/s5.refuelling.heating*.json, field kernel_only_comparison. The net direction is not established for Ag-110m and Cs-134.

A1: the model fraction is a fraction of one intact particle's inventory; a compact total that is not matrix-corrected includes inventory that was already outside the SiC, so it is at most an upper bound.

window_start_sensitivity.label: prescribed input (assumed)
window_start_sensitivity.reason: the source gives no exact start of the window ("about 24 h"); the value used above is 24 h

window_bounds.comparison_class: window upper bound under premise BP1
window_bounds.time_window: after about 24 h at T to end of 300 h plateau (or test end if shorter) (matrix-corrected)
window_bounds.particle_applicability: compact with intact particles only, matrix-corrected (release after the first 24 h); equals the mean intact-particle release fraction after about 24 h only if no release from outside the SiC occurs after about 24 h (an assumption of the source, not a measurement; a window upper bound); nearest AGR-1 analogue of a single intact particle; under premise BP1; window to the end of the 300 h plateau or the shorter test end (Collin p. 4)
window_bounds.premise_source: window upper bound under premise BP1 (the premise is the source's assumption, not an established fact)
window_bounds.window_end_origin: end of the 300 h plateau (Collin et al. 2016, manuscript p. 4); the as-run hold of 303 h (TH-036 (history AGR1-ASRUN-4-4-3)) is longer and is not the window end
window_bounds.systematic_uncertainty: 5 % gamma counting (Stempien 2023 p. 10), kept separate and not combined into any number on a graph
